result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **Stripe is the best all-around payment processor**, but if you're using Shopify, I'd recommend **Shopify Payments** instead.

The best option depends on your ecommerce platform, sales volume, and where your customers are located.

## Top 5 payment processors

![CPGIO - Multichannel eCommerce Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/PjgYNLsLO5kyHaLbRGf_vEGDklf86yBgljtBg18t7Dvw-WgJwtAR87t17RVnZQNRleNsnU2jfdTsx-hJkwGMn58MvL69dhGg6Mz4413HP_F8ItDmZVpm38tgVXpxLOBbHgVAgnhtZKjtJgc5PKyPg4Dx8NXHfNqw_93O-hccPsS0BrwP9sqrs9aaI_I6CV7n?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- No monthly processing fee.
- Easy integration with WooCommerce, Wix and custom websites.
- Supports subscriptions and international payments.
- Excellent reporting and fraud protection.

Best for: Independent online stores.

[Stripe website](https://stripe.com)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Built directly into Shopify.
- Simplifies refunds and order management.
- Avoids additional Shopify third-party transaction fees.
- Supports major credit cards and digital wallets.

Best for: Stores already running on Shopify.

[Shopify Payments website](https://www.shopify.com/ca/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

- Recognized and trusted by many shoppers.
- Offers PayPal checkout.
- Easy to integrate with most ecommerce platforms.

Best for: Giving customers another familiar payment option.

[PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/ca/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Simple payment setup.
- Integrates online and in-person sales.
- Offers point-of-sale hardware.

Best for: Businesses selling both online and in physical locations.

[Square Canada](https://squareup.com/ca/en)

---

![Top five fintech news stories of the week: 28 August 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Nvwm5m0AvFIyEQCoAUiuiBYsES5Z_TGIIL3a7sg7Vv4eL9Itvfc5xa-EyPsr8IsSKHecG5NYexO0SMIejzwZMML07_ctHuEIL4ButxRVQGAmBUqOEkJLjZgpEozhbgzBigkUW3PNM8qwMbcubKNhZeml3Fh_1lYV5P7aYAnQGGfgg1x4XdQzyp-dffUe_NGw?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Helcim**

- Interchange-plus pricing.
- No standard monthly subscription.
- Can become cost-effective as transaction volume grows.

Best for: Growing businesses looking to reduce processing costs.

[Helcim website](https://www.helcim.com)

## My recommendation

Since you're potentially operating in Canada, I'd initially compare Stripe, Shopify Payments and Helcim.

| Processor | Best use |
|--------|--------|
| Stripe | Flexibility and integrations |
| Shopify Payments | Shopify stores |
| PayPal | Additional checkout option |
| Square | Online and physical sales |
| Helcim | Cost-conscious growing stores |


For reference, Stripe's standard Canadian online domestic card pricing is generally around 2.9% + C\$0.30 per transaction. Check current rates and eligibility before signing up.
